comparison_kind: same production source repeatability; no performance improvement or threshold claimed

gaps: P6-R requires P5-D deletion and upgraded Warlock; neither is invoked by this harness.
Native endpoint abort and real Warlock adapter conformance are not proved by controlled hosts.
Owner probe holds are measured; all production coordinator/owner hold intervals are not instrumented.
PHY worker counts and sampled process threads are observed; exact REL worker count/wake-loop frequency await owning-lane diagnostics.
Sampled RSS is not an allocator-exact peak; OS file cache is not flushed.

baseline.cache_policy: fresh physical fixture files per process; OS cache not flushed; first repetition is not claimed cold

values.scope: one direct owner read versus 100 public summary reads; not instrumentation of all production critical sections

values.latency_scope: includes queued wait, detach, physical restart and commit
